name: checkbox
origin: shadcn/ui, style: aria-nova (base: react-aria-components). Pair with an external Label via id/htmlFor — Checkbox's own children slot is for a custom indicator override, not label text.
description: A control for a single on/off/indeterminate value. Pair with an external Label (via id/htmlFor) laid out as a flex row rather than passing label text as children.
